description: 2025-26 tax returns are due 31 October 2026, a Saturday, so self-lodgers have until Monday 2 November 2026. Late: $364 per 28 days; GIC 11.51%.

title: Air Traffic Controller Pay Rise October 2026: 3.4%, New Salaries
h1: Air Traffic Controllers Get 3.4% Pay Rise on 7 October 2026: Level 1 Rises to $125,564, Level 10 to $243,589
description: Airservices controllers get the final 3.4% rise under their 2024-2027 agreement on 7 October 2026: Level 1 to $125,564, Level 10 to $243,589.

title: Award Transport Payments: Withholding Starts 1 October 2026
h1: Tax Now Withheld From Award Transport Payments From 1 October 2026: What It Does to Your Pay
description: From 1 October 2026 employers must withhold tax from award transport payments. On a $22 weekly allowance, a $1,300-a-week worker has about $7 more withheld.

title: LISTO Boost 2027: $45,000 Income Limit, $810 Payment
h1: LISTO Boost: Income Limit Rises to $45,000 and the Payment to $810 From 1 July 2027
description: From 1 July 2027 the low income super tax offset income limit rises from $37,000 to $45,000 and the maximum from $500 to $810. It is now law.
